Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one sharp held animation pose for a pixel-art fighting game.
Edit the attached Arthur sprite. SAME baby identity, blue eyes with white highlights, hair, red headband, white nappy, chubby body, existing pixel-art texture and palette. SAME 1448x1086 transparent canvas, camera, source scale, head position and framing. Both feet stay in exactly the reference positions with soles on source y1044. Do not move or resize legs. Keep the face, expression and headband unchanged; concentrate the animation in arms and shoulders.
The animation direction is short, sharp limited animation with strong graphic poses and abrupt transitions, inspired by the energy of Gorillaz's original Clint Eastwood music video, while keeping Arthur's existing pixel-art design and cheerful face. No soft tween poses, motion blur, glow or smear. No text, impact effects, background, shadow or extra characters.
Arthur faces RIGHT. The arm/fist on image RIGHT is the punching lead arm. The fist on image LEFT stays near his chest in guard. Never add a third arm. Output one full-body character pose with genuine transparent background.
POSE: very compact anticipation before a quick straight jab. Pull the RIGHT-side fist inward toward his right shoulder, around x870,y500, with the elbow bent back. Turn that shoulder back slightly, forming a clear angular silhouette. His LEFT-side guarding fist stays near x655,y505. Slight torso tension, no head movement. Both feet remain planted.
